about: Guests of Market Bubble whose voice has been confirmed on camera. Each entry was checked from a frame of the broadcast: the name under the guest's tile, the banner, and that the guest is the one speaking at the second given. 'role' is the show's own banner at that moment, in ordinary case; empty when the banner gave none. 'plate' is the name guest_windows.json has for the window. 'anchor' is the transcript line being spoken in that frame. scripts/guest_voices.py takes the voice of that line as the guest's voice.
